content:
**Magnetic Personality** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*..

Gain Charisma for each party member.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Gain 2 Charisma for each teammate, excluding yourself. | 00323F94 | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain 1 Charisma for each teammate, excluding yourself. | 00323F92 |
